source_title: Every Quest and How Long to Beat Final Fantasy Resonance - GameRant
source_excerpt:
Steve is a Guides Contributor at GameRant. He discovered a passion for video games with the original Sonic the Hedgehog game on the Sega Genesis. His love deepened with the original Pokémon Red and Blue games and has been playing Pokémon games ever since.It helped cultivate his love for writing guides, specifically team and build guides for RPGs.
Steve has an MA in English and an MFA in Dramatic Writing at Missouri State University. He also writes screenplays and Twine games on the side. When he isn't busy writing and researching articles, he spends time with his wife and two daughters.
Final Fantasy Resonance splits its quests into two categories: Main and Sub. The main quests will progress the overall story and unlock new regions to explore. The sub quests, or side quests, are still worth doing because there are some wonderful rewards that will help you on your journey. This guide will list every chapter and sub quest in Final Fantasy Resonance , along with the rewards for completing every sub quest.
The main quest of Final Fantasy Resonance is broken up into 8 different Chapters:
Each of these chapters has their own set of sub quests that become available at various points during the chapter.
There are some spoilers in a few of the later quests. They are hidden, but you can click on them to reveal them when you reach those quests.
How Long Does it Take to Beat Final Fantasy Resonance?
If you only do the main quests, it can take 40-60 hours to finish the game.
Doing every sub quest as well will take about 60-80 hours.
Finally, collecting and completing everything in the game can easily take over 100 hours.
